notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Drafna.
Drafna does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Su-Chi by paying {4}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying the Su-Chi spell.
Resolve the copy of the Su-Chi spell, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Su-Chi token, adding {C}{C}.
The token Su-Chi dies, triggering itself and Drafna.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Drafna trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
